facts.fact: Raxio Group's Namanve data centre in Kampala (about 1,000 sqm, up to 250 racks, 1.5 MW), carrier- and cloud-neutral, launched in 2021 and by late February 2026 hosted Equity Bank Uganda's core operations, per DataCenterDynamics.

DataCenterDynamics reports Raxio's Namanve data centre, launched in 2021, was claimed to be Uganda's first Tier-III certified carrier- and cloud-neutral data centre (operator claim, certifying body not named).
